target.title: fix(ai): keep OpenAI tool call id truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where OpenAI-provider tool-call conversations could send invalid Unicode in outbound `tool_call_id` values when an oversized ID contained a UTF-16 surrogate pair straddling the 40-code-unit truncation boundary.

## Why This Change Was Made

`normalizeToolCallId` truncated with `id.slice(0, 40)`. `String.prototype.slice` cuts UTF-16 code units, so a surrogate pair such as 🐱 (`\uD83D\uDC31`) at positions 39–40 left an unpaired high surrogate on the wire.

The fix switches that OpenAI branch to the existing repo helper `truncateUtf16Safe` from `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice` (same helper used by sibling UTF-16 surfaces). Non-OpenAI provider paths and the pipe-separated ID branch are unchanged.

Collision check: searched open PRs; no same-file or same-problem open PR was found.

## User Impact

- Multi-model `openai` provider tool-call conversations keep valid Unicode in truncated IDs
- IDs without a surrogate pair at the 40-unit boundary behave as before
- Non-OpenAI provider truncation paths are unchanged

## Evidence

Exact head: `ffc5501fffdcaf302f6586b496c271db49945379`

Focused regression test still passes:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  47 passed (47)
```

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior or issue addressed: Oversized OpenAI tool-call IDs whose surrogate pair crosses the 40 UTF-16 code-unit limit no longer leave an unpaired high surrogate in the outbound `/v1/chat/completions` request body.
- Real environment tested: Windows 10 + Node v24.17.0 + local checkout at `ffc5501fffdcaf302f6586b496c271db49945379`.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  ```bash
  node --import tsx scripts/proof-openai-tool-call-id-utf16-loopback.mts
  ```
  The committed harness starts a redacted loopback OpenAI-compatible HTTP server on `127.0.0.1`, drives production `streamOpenAICompletions` through the real OpenAI SDK (no Vitest mock of `openai`), and prints the `tool_call_id` bytes the server actually received on `POST /v1/chat/completions`.
- Evidence after fix:
  ```text
  === OpenAI tool-call id UTF-16 loopback proof ===
  node=v24.17.0
  head=ffc5501fffdcaf302f6586b496c271db49945379
  loopback=http://127.0.0.1:51720/v1
  input_id_length=41 (39 ASCII + 🐱 @ [39,40])

  BEFORE semantics (raw String.prototype.slice(0, 40)):
  {
    "label": "raw_slice",
    "length": 40,
    "last_code_unit": "0xd83d",
    "trailing_high_surrogate": true,
    "prefix_preserved": true
  }

  AFTER fix (bytes received by loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoint):
  {
    "request_method": "POST",
    "request_path": "/v1/chat/completions",
    "stop_reason": "stop",
    "received_tool_call_id": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "analysis": {
      "label": "loopback_received",
      "length": 39,
      "last_code_unit": "0x61",
      "trailing_high_surrogate": false,
      "prefix_preserved": true
    }
  }

    ok: loopback received POST
    ok: loopback path includes chat/completions
    ok: stream completed (stop)
    ok: tool_call_id present on wire
    ok: no trailing high surrogate on wire
    ok: wire id length <= 40
    ok: prefix preserved on wire
    ok: raw slice still shows the bug baseline
    ok: wire id differs from broken raw slice

  === Summary ===
  ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 9 passed, 0 failed
  ```
- Observed result after fix: The production openai-completions runtime sent a 39-code-unit ASCII `tool_call_id` to the loopback endpoint with `trailing_high_surrogate: false`. The broken `slice(0, 40)` baseline still shows unpaired `0xd83d`, proving the wire path no longer emits that invalid Unicode.
- What was not tested: Live paid OpenAI API round-trip with a real API key; non-OpenAI provider truncation branches (intentionally unchanged).

## Current review state

- Next action: ClawSweeper re-review after loopback production-path proof was added and pushed.
- Waiting on: ClawSweeper proof judgment (`proof: sufficient`) and maintainer look.
- Addressed: previous P1 asking for redacted loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoint evidence of the received `tool_call_id` (helper-only / mocked-client proof was insufficient).
